name: Beijing Asiacom Information Technology Co,.Ltd
summary: Beijing Asiacom Information Technology Co,.Ltd engages in the provision of computing power infrastructure services in Canada. The company provides cloud and digital solutions, which include cloud integration, MSP management, private cloud construction, and hybrid cloud management services; computing power infrastructure services, such as computer maintenance and maintenance delivery, data center integration, and integrated delivery services; and system integration services.
